title: Bone Tomahawk
review: America is a brutal place, where rival factions shoot each other remorselessly when they cross paths. And it was even worse back then, too! I've been tricked into watching a western. It's bleak but not horrifying, until the third act where things get pretty gnarly. The violence and plight of these men is applied entirely by humans, and not the environment they live in. But then I suppose the long journeys between settlements is what makes this location more dangerous than others. Patrick Wilson is a legit actor who is sometimes fantastic, although he is also in rather a lot of lame superhero and horror franchise roles. This is one of the best performances I've seen from him. Kurt Russell is great as always.
